_note: Edit this file to manage the reviews shown on the site — no HTML changes needed, just commit & redeploy. Fields: name, role, stars (1-5), when, text (basic <b> allowed). The 12 below are STARTER/SAMPLE reviews written to match real community vibes — swap them out for genuine quotes from your Discord (with permission) as they come in.

reviews.name: ShinyHuntKat
reviews.text: Asked for a shiny 6IV Dragapult, had the seed in 4 seconds and it was hosting two minutes later. Exactly what spawned. This thing is black magic.

reviews.name: DracoMike
reviews.text: The screenshot search is unreal — I pasted a pic from a YouTube thumbnail and it identified the mon, set the filters, and found 12 matching seeds.

reviews.name: PaldeaPeach
reviews.text: I've used every seed tool out there. Nothing else shows IV radars, rewards, and the Discord embed preview before you commit. Premium doesn't even cover it.

reviews.name: Blueberry_Ben
reviews.text: Wishlisted a shiny Clefable and got a browser notification the second the bot hosted one. Joined, caught it, done. Feels illegal.

reviews.name: TeraQueenV
reviews.text: Batch-pasted 40 community seeds into the Decoder and it identified every single one, flagged the flawless 6IVs, and queued my picks in one click.

reviews.name: KitakamiKid
reviews.text: I'm new and the chat assistant literally coached me through countering a 6★ dragon tera Charizard. Won on the first try with the party it built.

reviews.name: NuzlockeNina
reviews.text: The OBS overlay + the live board = my whole stream setup. Chat watches the rotation and calls the next raid before I do.

reviews.name: HerbaMysticaHank
reviews.text: Filtering raids by reward drops (Herba Mystica gang rise up) changed my farming routine completely. Docked one star only because I want it for SwSh too.

reviews.name: IndyRaider317
reviews.text: Been here since the first bot. The fact that seeds from this site always match what the bot hosts — same engine, zero dupes-gone-wrong — is why this community wins.

reviews.name: GholdengoGoals
reviews.text: Leaderboard, achievements, a world map of hosts?! It plays like a AAA game menu. My whole squad migrated to PKM Universe.

reviews.name: VioletVal
reviews.text: Voice search while my hands were full of controller: 'shiny water tera Quagsire five star'. It heard me, found it, hosted it. We live in the future.

reviews.name: MossyMawile
reviews.text: The 3D viewer with the tera lighting is pure flex and I'm here for it. Also the seeds just… work. Every time. ★ Copy, !ra, catch.
